title: PCR Set-Up
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare reaction mix
steps.instruction: Combine water, mastermix, and reverse primers in a reservoir to create the PCR reaction mix.

steps.title: Distribute reaction mix to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Using a multichannel pipette, dispense the reaction mix into each well of the 96‑well PCR plate.

steps.title: Add barcoded forward primers
steps.instruction: Transfer each uniquely barcoded forward primer to its corresponding well of the PCR plate containing the reaction mix.

steps.title: Add samples to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the appropriate sample from the KingFisher (or PlateOne) deep‑well plate into the matching well of the PCR plate.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to layout
steps.instruction: Place the KingFisher Deep Well Plate (samples) in slot 1, the Opentrons 200 µL filter tip rack in slot 2, the NEST 12‑well reservoir (15 mL) and the NEST 96‑well PCR plate in their designated slots as shown in the deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the deck, tip racks, and pipette in the OT‑App using calibration tips according to the support instructions.

steps.title: Upload protocol and run
steps.instruction: Upload the completed protocol file to the OT‑App (version 3.21.0 or later) and press “Run” to execute the automated PCR set‑up.
